notes:
A bigger TV update, shaped by testing on a real TV.

Home looks more like the Google TV home screen: the featured title fills the top with its art fading into the page and keeps turning while highlighted. Favorites and Recently watched are rows of tiles showing what's on. Hold Left on the featured banner for the menu.

Settings > Remote control works like TiviMate's: a TV guide list and a Player list, a press and a hold for each button, catch-up seeking options and Restore to defaults. In full screen, Up and Down change channel, Left opens the guide, hold Left shows the controls, and Pg+ or Pg- shows another channel's info without switching. In the guide, hold Back returns to full screen on Android 12 and earlier.

Hold OK on a Live TV group to rename, hide, lock or rearrange groups.

Movies and Shows on TV are one page like Home, with Continue watching on it. Sports buttons are tidier, the menu is see-through, and Live TV has background choices in Settings > Appearance instead of the channel's logo.

Tested on an Android TV emulator, not yet on a real TV.
